title: Hooks and merge driver active on a fresh clone without a script
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. A fresh clone gets the workflow hooks and ledger merge driver through a mechanism the agent cannot skip by not running setup-dev.sh. Integration test zc_hooks_on_clone.rs.
